title: fun pack 2 on its way!
author: bpatrick
body:
Already in the mail:

Here’s a look at what went out in the first fun pack.

comments.author: D
comments.text:
“Oh no!”, I say too! That funpack is leaving us hanging in the air. I hope we’re going to see more Zeno! At least it smells like another epic story arc (Or did I miss the punchline?!)

Too bad your printer isn’t worthy of the comics you make it print … Anyway, amazing funpack, it made for a happy day for me, thank you.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: Upon seeing the Onan print, I am going to finally submit myself to the temptations of online shopping by setting up a Paypal account. Let’s just hope all of Jonny’s paychecks don’t turn into foreign anime, figurines, and expensive exercise sets.

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.text:
@D: I was absolutely intending to include an apology for my printer in the pack and then sealed them up after forgetting. Let me say now: I’m sorry about my printer. I think there’s a learning curve and the next mini-comic is going to be so much better. Glad you liked it!
@Jonny Paycheck: I am going to do the most badass Onan drawing for you!

comments.author: kevin
comments.text: Was this sent out already? I’m anxiously waiting!

comments.author: du lich sapa cat cat ham rong
Mike
comments.text: Your artwork looks amazing uncoloured… you seem to harm it when you add colour.
